issues.jp_before: 薬[くすり]{は|wa-topic}水[みず]{と一緒[いっしょ]に/と|toisshoni}飲[の]んでください。
issues.problem: Bare と (水と飲む) is not natural for taking medicine with water, so it should not be listed as an alternative.

issues.jp_before: 牛乳[ぎゅうにゅう]{と一緒[いっしょ]に/と|toisshoni}パン{を|o-object}食[た]べる{の|no-nominalizer}{が|ga-stative}好[す]きです。
issues.problem: With the と alternative, 牛乳とパンを食べる means 'eat milk and bread', which is semantically odd. The English is awkward, and it was the fourth use of 食べる in the batch.
issues.action: Replaced with コーヒー{と一緒に/と}ケーキを頼みました (same skill).

issues.jp_before: 一人[ひとり]{で|de-scope}住[す]んでいる祖母[そぼ]{のこと|nokoto}{が|ga-subject}心配[しんぱい]です。
issues.problem: が before 心配です marks the object of a feeling predicate, which is ga-stative, not ga-subject.
issues.action: Changed the skill id to ga-stative.

issues.jp_before: ちゃんと将来[しょうらい]{のこと|nokoto}{を|o-object}考[かんが]えなさい。
issues.problem: The why says 'turns a person', but 将来 is not a person.

issues.jp_before: 昔[むかし]{のこと|nokoto}{を|o-object}思[おも]い出[だ]す{と|to-conditional}、少[すこ]し悲[かな]しくなります。
issues.problem: The why says 'turns a person', but 昔 is not a person.

issues.jp_before: 昨日[きのう]、祖父[そふ]{に/から|ni-source}若[わか]い頃[ころ]{のこと|nokoto}{を|o-object}聞[き]きました。
issues.problem: The why says 'turns a person', but 若い頃 is a period of time.

issues.jp_before: 母[はは]{は|wa-topic}私[わたし]{のこと|nokoto}{を|o-object}よく分[わ]かっています。
issues.problem: 分かる also takes が (the prescriptive particle), and が is equally natural here, so it was missing as an alternative.

issues.jp_before: 他[ほか]{の|no-possessive}人[ひと]{のこと|nokoto}{を|o-object}気[き]にしない方[ほう]{が|ga-stative}いい{よ|yo-assertion}。
issues.problem: In 方がいい, が marks the subject of いい, not the object of a stative predicate.
issues.action: Changed the skill id to ga-subject.

issues.jp_before: 彼女[かのじょ]{は|wa-topic}病気[びょうき]{の|no-possessive}母親[ははおや]{のこと|nokoto}{を|o-object}一人[ひとり]{で|de-scope}世話[せわ]しています。
issues.problem: The sentence is unnatural: 世話する takes 〜の世話をする, not 〜のことを世話する, so the answer key teaches a wrong collocation.
issues.action: Replaced with 入院している母親のことを毎日気にかけています (f=1) and gave it a new why.

issues.jp_before: 恥[は]ずかしい{ので|node-because}、好[す]きな人[ひと]{のこと|nokoto}{を|o-object}友達[ともだち]{に|ni-recipient}言[い]えません。
issues.problem: から is an equally natural reason particle here and was not listed.
issues.action: Changed the slot to {ので/から|node-because}.

issues.jp_before: 旅行[りょこう]{のこと|nokoto}{を|o-object}友達[ともだち]{と|to-with}相談[そうだん]しました。
issues.problem: 友達に相談しました fits the English just as well and was not listed.

issues.jp_before: あの先生[せんせい]{は|wa-topic}生徒[せいと]{のこと|nokoto}{を|o-object}最後[さいご]{まで|made-until}信[しん]じていました。
issues.problem: The English assumed the teacher's gender ('his students').
issues.action: Changed it to 'believed in the students'.

issues.jp_before: 夫[おっと]{は|wa-topic}仕事[しごと]{のこと|nokoto}{を|o-object}家[いえ]{で|de-place}あまり話[はな]しません。
issues.problem: A near-duplicate of the item 自分の家族のことをあまり話しません (same verb and frame), and the why was wrong (work is not a person).
issues.action: Replaced with 夫は家で仕事のことを聞かれるのが嫌いです (f=2).

issues.jp_before: 去年[きょねん]死[し]んだ犬[いぬ]{のこと|nokoto}{を|o-object}まだ忘[わす]れられません。
issues.problem: The why says 'turns a person', but the noun is a dog.

issues.jp_before: 父[ちち]{は|wa-topic}家族[かぞく]{のこと|nokoto}{が|ga-subject}一番[いちばん]大切[たいせつ]です。
issues.problem: The skill id was ga-subject, but が here marks the object of the feeling predicate 大切, so ga-stative is correct. The why ('like or worry about') did not fit 大切.
issues.action: Changed the skill id to ga-stative and rewrote the why.
